llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all alphabetic characters from main body paragraphs and tables, then checks all are lowercase — directly verifying sub-goal 1.

Getter inspects footer XML for the 'PAGE' field instruction (stored uppercase in OOXML as <w:instrText> PAGE </w:instrText>), which is a reliable method for detecting page number fields — directly verifying sub-goal 2.
Metric awards 0.5 per sub-goal with appropriate partial credit logic; both sub-goals fully covered.
expected.type='rule' with empty rules={} is handled correctly — the metric ignores `expected` and relies solely on the getter result.
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S + 2s sleep) before getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.

Minor gap: doc.paragraphs in python-docx does not include header/footer paragraphs, so any text labels added alongside the PAGE field in the footer are not checked for lowercase. This is an acceptable limitation given the instruction focuses on document body text.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: extend the getter to also iterate over section footer paragraphs (section.footer.paragraphs) for alpha characters, to fully cover 'all text in the document' including footer text labels.
